targets.title: Void Claw and Warden’s Blight route
targets.description: Use Pack-a-Punch, recover the Fracture and follow the temple route. The three body locations in the separate forest are not positions on this overview.

targets.title: Her House and Void Talon
targets.description: Shoot the basketball and symbols from the Forge, then complete Exfil to return to Her House. The Eye is in the upstairs bathroom; empower a Void Claw pedestal afterwards.

targets.title: Swirling Pool cubes
targets.description: One cube is on the GobbleGum pillar; two are at the Mule Kick windows; one is near the Void Claw pedestal. Area guidance does not distinguish the two window heights.

targets.title: Restart the Nexus Forge
targets.description: Free the three pillar switches and six panels, remove webs, surge the Forge, then use the ground switch next to Deadshot on the lower level.

targets.title: Temple cleansing rooms
targets.description: Align the Nexus pillars toward each temple before its cauldron, tile, reflector and visage steps. These are room highlights, not exact wall or tile positions.

targets.title: Temple cauldrons and Titan Traps
targets.description: Dravakar and Caltheris use the Caltheris Passage trap; Nyxara and Veytharion use the Veytharion Passage trap.

targets.title: Temple quest-item areas
targets.description: Hammer: Dravakar shields; Scroll: the forest reached from Nyxara; Thread: purple orbs (Caltheris can supply more); Sash: one of the three islands during rain.

targets.title: Woven Sash candidates
targets.description: Check outside the islands during rain: after the second Spira platform, behind the Ruinas Mystery Box wall, or below the Aranea approach from Veytharion.

targets.title: Warden boss encounter entrance
targets.description: Stand in the Nexus Core circles to start. The later boss arena and intermediate room are separate destinations and are not plotted.

targets.title: Void Claw pedestals
targets.description: Published pedestal locations. The Eye of the Forge can empower a pedestal to provide Void Talon.

targets.title: Dig spots
targets.description: Published dig spots. The cassette is a random reward, so check multiple spots.
